summary: ```# How to Participate in the Competition Jointly Organized by Marvelous Designer and Leartes Studios ## Introduction Hello everyone, I am Xueli. I believe everyone already knows that Marvelous Designer and Leartes Studios have held a 3D asset competition together. In this video, I will explain how to sign up and what to do after joining the Discord channel. ## Competition Overview First, let's take a look at the competition rules and introductions. After logging into Marvelous Designer's official website, scroll down to find the news interface. In the news interface, locate the announcement regarding Leartes and Marvelous Designer. After clicking, a page with a brief introduction to our competition will open. ### Competition Name and Theme Our competition is called the **Monthly 3D Asset Adjustment**. This competition is held every month and has been ongoing since May 2022. The theme for each month's competition is different, and it is usually announced at the end of the month. After the announcement, you can start creating your own 3D assets based on this theme. The 3D assets are not limited to 3D clothing; you can also use props or materials. If you miss the registration time, don't worry! You can register for the next month. Our competition will continue until the end of 2022. ## Awards Next, let's take a look at some of the awards in this competition. The awards are divided into two categories: the Basic Award and the Special Selection Award. The Special Selection Award is named after the exclusive rating of Marvelous Designer. Therefore, if you want to participate in this award, you need to use Marvelous Designer to complete your work, although you can combine it with other 3D software. ### Prizes for Special Selection Award For the Marvelous Designer Special Selection Award, you will receive: 1. One year of the personal version of Marvelous Designer. 2. A gift card worth 200 USD from Steam or Google Play (these two gift cards are optional). ### Other Prizes Here we can see that the prizes for the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd places are also very generous. I hope everyone can participate in this competition! ## Competition Page On the competition page, you can see the theme of each month. Remember to check the competition page before participating to know the current theme. The page also includes the registration timeframe and the registration date. ### Registration and Discord Channel The next button directs you to the Discord channel for our competition. Discord is a real-time chat software where a lot of news will be released, so please remember to register and log in. ## Monthly Schedule Each month, we open registration at the end of the month after announcing the new theme. You can register in Discord, and after completing your registration, you can submit your competition work at the beginning of the following month. For example, if you register at the end of May, you can start submitting your work on June 5th. Submissions also need to be done on Discord. ### Submission Deadline Please note that if you haven't participated in the Discord channel before the deadline, your submission will not be accepted. Remember to register for the competition first; otherwise, you won't be able to submit your work. ## Competition Rules Let's take a look at the rules for this competition: 1. Ensure that the design concept of your work is created by you. If the art concept is from someone else, you must submit an authorization document from the original owner. 2. All models must be submitted at the same time, and all model materials must be your own independent design. If you use another model or material, it must be significantly different from the source. 3. You can use any 3D and material production software. If you use Marvelous Designer, you can participate in the Marvelous Designer selection. 4. Your work must be based on the theme of the competition and aligned with the game production process. 5. Render your final product using an 8-hole or other real-time rendering engines like Unreal or Unity. 6. Adjust your final rendering product in Photoshop. 7. Comply with the rules set by Leartes Studios. Non-compliance may lead to disqualification. 8. If you do not sign up in advance or join the Discord channel, you will not earn points. ## Discord Guidelines Let's discuss how to use Discord: ### Overview of Discord Discord is a chat platform where you can find announcements from the official channel and communicate with other users interested in this competition. After entering the official Discord channel of Leartes Studios, click on "Rules" on the left to see the official channel rules. ### Group Navigation You can switch between different groups by clicking on the title names near the arrow keys on the far left. Each group contains different content, such as announcements, technical questions, and portfolios. ### Key Rules 1. Abide by the official Discord rules. 2. Ensure your Discord name and ArtStation name are in English for better integration. 3. Do not tag everyone in the group unnecessarily or share unrelated information. 4. Ban any illegal activities, including plagiarism. 5. Communicate respectfully and professionally. 6. Avoid discussing sensitive political topics. 7. Post appropriate information in suitable groups. 8. Obtain permission from channel management before promoting your work. ## Important Groups ### Announcements Group In the announcements group, official staff will post relevant information, such as changes to the submission deadline. For example, the last day for submissions may change to 11:59 PM on June 20, according to Taiping Yang time. ### Previous Announcements At the end of the month, we will usually publish the registration link for the next month and any submission rules that need to be adhered to. ## Submission Rules 1. Each contestant must use a watermark provided by us, and the work needs to be uploaded to ArtStation. 2. When sharing your work on ArtStation, label it as "Lurtis Marvelous Challenge." 3. Fill in the description box with required information, including a paragraph stating your participation in the competition. 4. Upload at least three renderings and one transparent frame of your contest work. Sharing more renderings or a video is highly recommended. ## Sharing Contest Work On the left, click on "Completed Works" to share your finished work. Before sharing, ensure you have registered in advance. ### Viewing Contest Work You can view previous contestants' works, which will help you understand the necessary content to include in your own submission. ## Registration Process To sign up, return to the registration link provided. If you're using a Google account, your progress will be saved automatically. Fill in your details, including your Discord ID, which consists of a name and a string of numbers. ### Final Reminders Remember to join our Discord channel, as all sharing and submissions will be based there. Click "Yes" to proceed to the next page, where you'll fill in additional relevant information. Thank you for your attention, and good luck with your submissions! ```
